criteria: bioforge.html is one large self-contained file (no external libraries) simulating an evolving 2D ecosystem: organisms carrying a genome (size, speed, vision, metabolism, reproduction, mutation) that search for food, move, reproduce, mutate, age and die; a day/night cycle and environmental controls; live population and average-trait charts drawn with canvas or SVG; an organism inspector, pause/speed controls, seeded generation and save/load. Responsive and stable with many organisms.

review.description: Artificial-life ecosystem simulator: genome-driven organisms, food/predation, day/night, live trait charts, inspector, seeded generation + save/load. Large stress case.
